title: SITVIT2 spoligotype patterns from SpolLineages (mirror for spoligotyper)
description: Unmodified copy of Spoligo_list.csv from the SpolLineages repository (https://github.com/dcouvin/SpolLineages): 9,658 spoligotype patterns of the SITVIT2 database with their SITVIT2 family and shared international type (SIT). Mirrored for spoligotyper (https://github.com/duceppemo/spoligotyper), which downloads it with spoligotyper-download-sit when GitHub cannot be reached. Licensed under GPL-3.0, like SpolLineages. Please cite Couvin et al. 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1093/database/baaa108) and Couvin et al. 2019 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.meegid.2018.12.030).
